items.q: You were talking about the gig with Rex Stewart and another one with Jimmy Rawles

ctx.x: You were talking about the gig with Rex Stewart and another one with Jimmy Rawles, and we didn't really talk about what year those were. Can we nail it down to time?
Well, I returned here in Los Angeles on Pearl Harbor Day. It was December the 7th. And --
